text:
Carol will likely win. The "as is" clause disclaims only implied warranties, so it does not protect a seller who expressly misdescribes the car's model year in the ad and on the website. The seller's best reply, that the photo was only illustrative, is weak because the ad itself stated 1964. Since the team note lists the seller's negligence argument as the other possible answer, my confidence is moderate.

CONFIDENCE: 65
